properties.description: A report lists each open overlay: branch, worktree, the records it touches, its age, and the seat and claim behind it. loop_status mentions it when another branch touches ground this session is working. Ordinary reads never include another branch's facts. Depends on claim liveness being true. Designed 2026-09-23 (dec:what-a-session-on-main-sees-of-in-flight-branches).
properties.name: Other branches' in-flight facts are visible in an explicit view, never mixed into ordinary reads
